# MyTutor

> MyTutor (mrcadabra.com) is a warm, talking AI math tutor for homeschool families,
> students, and classrooms. The tutor, "Mr. Cadabra," teaches foundation-first — he introduces each idea and its
> vocabulary explicitly before asking about it. He speaks
> each step aloud in a natural voice, draws the work on a synchronized whiteboard that
> never runs ahead of the student, and asks guiding questions instead of handing over
> answers. Students talk with him - a real spoken back-and-forth (speech is
> transcribed to text and the audio deleted immediately, never stored); they can
> also type, use tap-to-plot graph paper, and elementary students tap answer
> buttons. Made by Hyperion Shift LLC.

Key facts:
- Ten complete courses, each with nine units: Entry-Level Math, Basic Math,
  Pre-Algebra, Algebra I, Geometry, Algebra II, Trig / Pre-Calc, Calculus,
  Differential Equations, and Probability & Statistics.
- A voluntary placement assessment starts each student exactly where they belong;
  mastery is proven with scored unit checks (80%+), never assumed.
- Parents get a read-only dashboard with honest time-on-task (idle minutes count as
  zero), real mastery status, and a plain-language "How are they doing, really?"
  narrative assessment.
- Rewards system: merit badges per mastered unit, course trophies, and effort medals
  for streaks, practice, and comebacks.
- Teachers and co-ops get a roster view and a per-class mastery heatmap.
- Pricing: a free plan (placement, first mastered unit, unlimited practice help), then
  one full-access plan at $29/month per student or $24/month billed annually
  (introductory pricing). Currently in beta and not yet taking payments.
- Privacy: parents create and control accounts; only first names are stored for
  students; spoken answers are transcribed and the audio deleted immediately
  (voice recordings are never stored); student data is never sold or used for
  advertising.
